inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped sales report combines WITH ROLLUP hierarchy flags with RANK over aggregate totals, partitioning ranks by subtotal level and parent dimension before ordering the hierarchy.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a compact regional profit report. Store profits group by region and county with rollup, explicit NULL checks identify detail, regional subtotal, and grand-total rows, and RANK orders counties or subtotal rows within their parent. TPC-DS tables, filters, grouping flags, and values are newly authored.

fixture_notes: North has counties Alpha and Beta plus a subtotal; South has county Gamma; the grand total is included. Rank partitions follow rollup level and parent region, preserving ties by rank.
determinism_notes: Region, county, profit values, rollup ordering, rank partitions, and final order are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE regional_profits (profit_id INT PRIMARY KEY, region_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, county_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, net_profit INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH rollup_totals AS (SELECT region_code, county_code, SUM(net_profit) AS total_profit FROM regional_profits GROUP BY region_code, county_code WITH ROLLUP), ranked_rollup AS (SELECT region_code, county_code, total_profit, CASE WHEN region_code IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN county_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS rollup_level, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CASE WHEN region_code IS NULL THEN 2 WHEN county_code IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN county_code IS NULL THEN region_code END ORDER BY total_profit DESC) AS profit_rank FROM rollup_totals) SELECT region_code, county_code, total_profit, rollup_level, profit_rank FROM ranked_rollup ORDER BY rollup_level DESC, region_code, profit_rank, county_code
